title: Mean of the Boolean dual
statement: For any Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, define its dual by $f^*(x)=-f(-x)$, where negation is applied to every input coordinate. The mean of the real-valued function associated to $f^*$ is the negative of the mean associated to $f$.
